known_issues: Adapted model gave a wrong/evasive answer to 'What's the capital of Australia?' (base model answered correctly: Canberra) — a genuine regression introduced by this training run, confirmed via direct base-vs-adapted comparison on the same prompt.

Adapted model's responses are systematically terser than base across all sampled capability prompts (not just food topics) — likely because both train.jsonl and capability_mix.jsonl were written in a short, direct style, so the LoRA picked up general response terseness alongside the intended bias.
